question: The gate is not green. Fix forward or take over?

request.title: Practice screen shows the camera hint
request.situation: Two merge checks are failing on the latest commit. The build job was cancelled by its 25-minute time limit.
request.ask: Should a fresh run fix the failing checks?

options.label: Fix in a fresh run
options.gain: No one has to touch the branch.

reversalCost.how: Stop the run; the pull request stays open.

ifNoAnswer.happens: The pull request stays open and falls behind main.
